---
title: "Prompts"
description: "Reusable prompts for designing and reviewing assessments."
---

Each prompt should state its purpose, required inputs, expected output, and points that the teacher must verify.

## Prompt template

::: {.callout-note title="Design an assessment"}
**Purpose:** Describe the intended use.

**Inputs:** Course level, learning outcomes, assessment format, duration, and constraints.

**Prompt:** Add the reviewed prompt here.

**Teacher checks:** List what must be verified before use.
:::
